title: When Closing Fees Are Charged and Reversed under Closing and Funding
content:
**Rule.** Closing and Funding closing fees follow the closing method's fee schedule and are charged on the Closing Disclosure, as follows.

| Fee | When it is charged |
|---|---|
| Closing method fee | once per closing |
| After-hours signing fee | once, when the signing is held on a weekday after 18:00 or on a Saturday or Sunday and the method offers after-hours signings |
| Courier fee | once for a mail-away package |
| Wire fee | once per outgoing funding wire; a wire re-sent after a Larkspur-side return is not charged again |
| Power of attorney review fee | once per power of attorney reviewed |
| Doc redraw fee | the clause "doc redraw fee once per borrower-caused redraw" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current redraw pricing basis |
| Cancellation fee | cancelling a closing costs the method's cancellation fee |

**Reversals.** A fee not in the method's schedule, or a redraw Larkspur caused, is reversed in full. A fee reversal applies only to a fee entry that has not already been reversed; the check reads the system record of reversals naming that fee entry.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- A signing on a Wednesday at 19:00 under a method that offers after-hours signings carries the after-hours signing fee once; the same signing at 17:30 does not.
- A wire returned for a Larkspur-side reason and re-sent carries one wire fee in total, not two.
- A fee entry that already carries a reversal is not reversed again.
